headline: India growth improving; cost efficiencies negating inflation

highlights: Domino’s LFL growth improved to 4.1% (2.5% in 1QFY27) despite a high base of 9%.
Delivery revenue grew 11.3%, and DITA revenue returned to growth at 2.4% after a prolonged period of weakness.
Popeyes continued its strong performance, with revenue growth of 122% and LFL growth of 53%.

The company is targeting 5–7% Domino’s LFL growth in FY27, with 3Q performance currently on track to meet company plans. ◼ Gross margin expanded 110bp YoY to 75.5% supported by pricing, better mix, supply chain efficiencies, and lower wastage.

We reiterate our BUY rating on the stock with TP of INR625, valuing the India business at 27x EV/EBITDA and international business at 15x EV/EBITDA on Sep’28E estimates.
watch: Domino’s Turkey LFL declined 2% and Coffy LFL declined 19% (inflation-adjusted).

Domino’s Sri Lanka and Bangladesh reported moderation in revenue growth of 9% and 12% YoY, respectively. ◼ We remain positive on JUBI’s medium-term outlook, supported by 5-7% LFL growth potential, strong Popeyes momentum, and healthy international performance.
